fusions.name: Kneading Paws
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Watchful Pounce
fusions.desc: A pounce that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range. Your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds after it lands.

fusions.name: Purring Circle
fusions.desc: Raises a warm circle where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Lingering Warmth
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
